versions.changelog:
Initial release of web-to-wechat: streamline web article publishing to WeChat Official Accounts.

- Scrapes any webpage content, intelligently reformats with AI, and generates cover/inline images automatically.
- Supports a wide range of sites, including WeChat articles, news, tech blogs, Zhihu, and CSDN.
- Publishes directly to the WeChat draft box with cleanly formatted HTML and compressed cover images.
- Requires setup of related skills (anything-to-wechat, file-to-wechat), Python dependencies, and WeChat account credentials.
- Handles both simple and JS-heavy web pages with fallback scraping methods and clear user guidance.
